# पाऊस · Rain

> Free hyperlocal India rain nowcast: will it rain at your exact spot in the next 0–2 hours?

Site: https://rain.ishannaik.com
Repo: https://github.com/Ishannaik/mumbai-rain
License: MIT

## What it is

- One-question weather product: leave now or wait. Cities across India; Mumbai keeps neighbourhood-level pins.
- Calibrated logistic model bias-corrects Open-Meteo forecasts (trained on Mumbai airport METAR); serves as plain JSON arithmetic in the browser.
- Independent ground truth: NOAA METAR present-weather (RA/DZ) at VABB (Mumbai airport) — not forecast-vs-forecast.
- Public scoreboard: https://rain.ishannaik.com/scoreboard
- Method / limits: https://rain.ishannaik.com/about
- Live metrics JSON: https://rain.ishannaik.com/metrics.json
- API: GET https://rain.ishannaik.com/api/nowcast?lat=19.06&lon=72.83&hours=2
  also ?locality=chennai or ?locality=bandra

## Honest claims

- Better-calibrated rain probability vs a hard raw mm threshold and climatology on a time-ordered holdout (when the logistic champion is live). Model labels are Mumbai airport, not a national rain gauge network.
- Not radar nowcasting; flood watch only near curated Mumbai hotspots.
- Not a paid service; $0 stack (static host + free APIs + GitHub Actions).

## Key pages

- / — live nowcast (geolocation + city/area picker grouped by state)
- /week — week outlook
- /air — air quality
- /scoreboard — model vs raw honesty board
- /about — method and non-claims
- /{locality} — per-place pages (e.g. /bandra, /chennai)

## Data

- Training diary: data/log.csv in the git repo (hourly collector)
- Model weights: /model.json
- Weather input: Open-Meteo (credit required)
- Places: /data/localities.json (Mumbai neighbourhoods + Indian cities)
